<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0816">
<title>Nam Hoàng · Góc game</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@600;800&family=Rajdhani:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script>try{var _t=localStorage.getItem("g_theme");if(_t)document.documentElement.dataset.theme=_t}catch(e){}</script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0a0816;--panel:#14102a;--line:#2b2250;--text:#efeaff;--mute:#9a92c4;--v:#8b5cff;--p:#ff3d81;--c:#29f0ff;
--head:"Orbitron","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;--body:"Rajdhani","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:600 1.1rem/1.6 var(--body);overflow-x:hidden}
canvas#fx{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.glow{position:fixed;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;left:0;top:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(139,92,255,.28),transparent 65%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--c);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
h2{font:800 clamp(1.5rem,4.5vw,2.3rem)/1.15 var(--head);margin:0 0 .4rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.tag{font:600 .8rem var(--head);color:var(--c);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sec{padding:70px 0 30px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:opacity .8s,transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.btn{font:700 1rem var(--body);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--text);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:.65rem 1.2rem;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .25s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px -8px var(--p)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 10px 28px -12px var(--c)}
/* BANNER */
.hero{min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:40px 0 30px;position:relative}
.hello{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.95rem;margin:0}
.clock{font:800 clamp(2.6rem,13vw,7.5rem)/1 var(--head);display:flex;gap:.04em;align-items:center;margin:.3em 0 .1em;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--c),var(--v),var(--p),var(--c));background-size:300% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:flow 6s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(139,92,255,.5))}
.clock .s{animation:flow 6s linear infinite,blink 1s steps(2) infinite}
.clock .colon{animation:blink 1s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes flow{to{background-position:300% 0}}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.25}}
.date{font:600 1.05rem var(--head);color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 1.4rem}
.glitch{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.glitch::before,.glitch::after{content:attr(data-t);position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.glitch::before{color:var(--p);animation:gl1 3s infinite steps(1);clip-path:inset(0 0 55% 0)}
.glitch::after{color:var(--c);animation:gl2 3s infinite steps(1);clip-path:inset(55% 0 0 0)}
@keyframes gl1{0%,92%,100%{transform:none}93%{transform:translate(-4px,1px)}96%{transform:translate(3px,-1px)}}
@keyframes gl2{0%,90%,100%{transform:none}91%{transform:translate(4px,-1px)}95%{transform:translate(-3px,1px)}}
.type{font:600 1.15rem var(--head);color:var(--text);min-height:1.8em}
.type::after{content:"▌";color:var(--c);animation:blink .8s steps(2) infinite}
/* NHẠC */
.music{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;margin-top:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(20,16,42,.82);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.music::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-2px;border-radius:20px;padding:2px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--a,0deg),var(--v),var(--c),var(--p),var(--v));-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;animation:spin 6s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@property --a{syntax:"<angle>";initial-value:0deg;inherits:false}
@keyframes spin{to{--a:360deg}}
.player{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/7;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#000}
.player iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block}
.pl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0}
.pl h3{margin:0 0 8px;font:700 .95rem var(--head);color:var(--c)}
.list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;overflow:auto;max-height:230px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s}
.list li:hover{transform:translateX(4px);border-color:var(--v)}
.list li.on{background:rgba(139,92,255,.2);border-color:var(--c)}
.list img{width:52px;height:30px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px;flex:none}
.list span{flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:.95rem}
.list button{background:none;border:0;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem}
.list button:hover{color:var(--p)}
.add{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.add input,.add .btn{font-size:.95rem}
input{font:600 1rem var(--body);background:#0d0a20;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:.5rem .8rem;min-width:0;flex:1}
.scroll{align-self:center;margin-top:26px;color:var(--mute);font:600 .8rem var(--head);letter-spacing:.3em;animation:bob 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(8px)}}
/* HỒ SƠ */
.me{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center;margin-top:20px}
.avatar{width:min(220px,40vw);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:28% 72% 63% 37%/40% 40% 60% 60%;overflow:hidden;position:relative;animation:morph 8s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--v),0 0 40px -4px var(--p)}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
@keyframes morph{50%{border-radius:63% 37% 30% 70%/50% 60% 40% 50%}}
.me h3{font:800 1.7rem var(--head);margin:0}
.me p{color:var(--mute);margin:.3rem 0 1rem;max-width:30em}
.socials{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.soc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:.55rem 1rem;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;font-weight:700}
.soc svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:currentColor}
.soc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-1.5deg);border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 12px 30px -14px var(--c);color:var(--c)}
/* GAME */
.open{margin-top:18px}
.chips{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.chips.on{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.chips>div{overflow:hidden;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 2px}
.chip{font:700 1rem var(--head);letter-spacing:.04em;padding:.7rem 1.2rem;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.9);transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s,background .3s}
.chips.on .chip{animation:chipin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1) forwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*80ms + 150ms)}
@keyframes chipin{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--c);transform:translateY(-4px)!important}
.chip[aria-expanded="true"]{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));border-color:transparent}
.gpanel{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.gpanel.on{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.gpanel>div{overflow:hidden}
.gh{margin:18px 0 12px;font:800 1.3rem var(--head);color:var(--c)}
.gh small{color:var(--mute);font:600 .95rem var(--body)}
/* Danh sách link chi tiết */
.item-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin:16px 0 24px;padding-left:8px}
.item-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);transition:all .25s;cursor:pointer}
.item-btn:hover{border-color:var(--c);transform:translateX(6px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px -10px var(--c)}
.item-btn b{font-size:1rem}
.item-btn span{color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem}
.link-list{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .4s ease}
.link-list.on{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.link-list>div{overflow:hidden;padding-left:12px;border-left:2px solid var(--v);margin:4px 0 4px 8px}
.link-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;margin:6px 0;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.08);transition:all .2s}
.link-item:hover{background:rgba(139,92,255,.18);transform:translateX(4px)}
.link-item a{color:var(--c);font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem}
.link-item .desc{color:var(--mute);font-size:.85rem;margin-left:auto}
.back-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.back-btn:hover{border-color:var(--p);color:var(--p)}
/* DONATE */
.donate-card{text-align:center;padding:32px 24px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:var(--panel);margin:20px 0}
.donate-card h3{font:700 1.4rem var(--head);color:var(--p);margin:0 0 8px}
.donate-card p{color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 24px;max-width:400px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.qr-wrap{width:min(280px,70%);margin:0 auto;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid var(--v);box-shadow:0 0 30px -8px var(--p)}
.qr-wrap img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.qr-note{margin-top:16px;color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem}
footer{padding:50px 0 40px;text-align:center;color:var(--mute);font-size:.95rem}
@media (max-width:760px){.socials{justify-content:center}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}.chip{opacity:1;transform:none}}
/* ===== TRANG TRÍ + HIỆU ỨNG (thêm mới) ===== */
.sec{position:relative}
#me{--k:var(--c)}#games{--k:var(--p)}#donate{--k:#ffb23e}
.tag{color:var(--k,var(--c))}
.sec::before{content:attr(data-n);position:absolute;right:-4px;top:24px;font:800 clamp(5rem,18vw,12rem)/1 var(--head);color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(139,92,255,.28);transform:translateY(var(--py,0px));pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.deco{position:absolute;z-index:-1;width:var(--s);height:var(--s);border:2px solid var(--k,var(--c));border-radius:22%;opacity:.2;pointer-events:none;translate:0 var(--dy,0px);animation:dspin 20s linear infinite}
@keyframes dspin{to{rotate:360deg}}
h2{perspective:600px}
.rv h2{position:relative;padding-bottom:.4em}
.rv h2::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;width:0;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--k,var(--c)),transparent);transition:width 1.1s .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv.in h2::after{width:min(240px,60%)}
.w{display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap}
.ch{display:inline-block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(.7em) rotateX(-85deg) scale(.7);filter:blur(10px);transition:opacity .6s var(--d),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1) var(--d),filter .7s var(--d)}
.in .ch{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none;animation:chg 1.4s var(--d) both}
@keyframes chg{0%{text-shadow:0 0 0 transparent}35%{text-shadow:0 0 22px var(--k,var(--c)),0 0 4px #fff}100%{text-shadow:0 0 0 transparent}}
.hud{background-image:linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))),linear-gradient(var(--k,var(--c)),var(--k,var(--c))));background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 0,0 0,100% 0,100% 0,0 100%,0 100%,100% 100%,100% 100%;background-size:22px 2px,2px 22px,22px 2px,2px 22px,22px 2px,2px 22px,22px 2px,2px 22px}
.me.hud{padding:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background-color:rgba(20,16,42,.6)}
.item-btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.item-btn::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 30%,rgba(139,92,255,.25) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .6s}
.item-btn:hover::before{transform:translateX(100%)}
.item-btn::after{content:"▾";margin-left:12px;color:var(--c);transition:transform .3s}
.item-btn.open::after{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#prog{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;height:3px;width:100%;transform-origin:0 0;transform:scaleX(0);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c),var(--v),var(--p));z-index:9997;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--v)}
.dots{position:fixed;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;z-index:50}
.dt{position:relative;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--mute);transition:all .3s}
.dt::after{content:attr(data-l);position:absolute;right:22px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(8px);opacity:0;white-space:nowrap;font:700 .75rem var(--head);padding:.15rem .6rem;border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);transition:all .25s;pointer-events:none}
.dt:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.dt.on{background:var(--c);border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--c);transform:scale(1.25)}
.totop{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));color:#fff;font:800 1.3rem var(--head);cursor:pointer;z-index:60;opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px) scale(.8);pointer-events:none;transition:all .35s}
.totop.on{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.totop:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 26px -6px var(--p)}
body.hc,body.hc *{cursor:none!important}
body.hc input,body.hc textarea{cursor:text!important}
.cdot{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:8px;height:8px;margin:-4px 0 0 -4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--c)}
.cring{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:38px;height:38px;margin:-19px 0 0 -19px;border:2px solid var(--v);border-radius:50%;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;transition:width .25s,height .25s,margin .25s,border-color .25s,background .25s}
.cring.hv{width:60px;height:60px;margin:-30px 0 0 -30px;border-color:var(--p);background:rgba(255,61,129,.12)}
.cring.dn{width:26px;height:26px;margin:-13px 0 0 -13px;border-color:var(--c)}
.sp{position:fixed;width:6px;height:6px;margin:-3px 0 0 -3px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;animation:spk .7s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes spk{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(0);opacity:0}}
/* Thư viện map */
.mapg{margin:4px 0 8px}
.mapbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 18px;align-items:center;padding:14px;margin:6px 0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.07)}
.mtot{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}.mtot b{font:800 2rem var(--head);color:var(--p)}.mtot span{color:var(--mute);font-size:.95rem}
.mq{flex:1 1 180px;min-width:150px}
.fl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex:1 1 100%}
.fl small{color:var(--mute);min-width:64px;font-size:.85rem}
.fg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.fc{font:700 .85rem var(--body);padding:.28rem .75rem;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.fc:hover{border-color:var(--c)}
.fc.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));border-color:transparent}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(205px,1fr));gap:14px}
.mcard{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;animation:cin .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) backwards;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.mcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -18px var(--c)}
.mth{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:#000}
.mth img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .6s}
.mcard:hover .mth img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.mth img{filter:contrast(1.05) saturate(1.06)}
.mth::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(10,8,22,.75))}
.pn,.sz{position:absolute;z-index:1;font:700 .75rem var(--body);padding:.1rem .55rem;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(10,8,22,.8);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pn{left:8px;top:8px}.sz{right:8px;top:8px}
.mb{padding:10px 12px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:1}
.mb b{font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.25;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.df{font:700 .78rem var(--head);padding:.12rem .6rem;border-radius:6px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.d0{background:rgba(62,224,138,.15);color:#3ee08a}.d1{background:rgba(41,240,255,.13);color:var(--c)}.d2{background:rgba(255,178,62,.15);color:#ffb23e}.d3{background:rgba(255,61,129,.16);color:var(--p)}
.d4{background:rgba(139,92,255,.25);color:#c9b3ff;animation:pls 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pls{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 8px -2px var(--v)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px 1px var(--v)}}
.mu{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--c);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mu:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.ma{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:auto}
.ma .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;font-size:.88rem;padding:.42rem .6rem}
.cp{font:700 .8rem var(--body);padding:.42rem .65rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.cp:hover{border-color:var(--c);color:var(--c)}
.mempty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--mute);padding:30px 0}
@media (max-width:760px){.dots{display:none}.sec::before{opacity:.6}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ch{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important}.deco{display:none}#prog{transition:none}}
.mrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}
html{overflow-x:hidden}
/* ===== V3: THANH MENU CỐ ĐỊNH · PLAYER · NÚT GAME · DI ĐỘNG ===== */
.topnav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:9990;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:rgba(10,8,22,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.topnav.sc{background:rgba(10,8,22,.9);border-color:var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px #000}
.tn{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;height:58px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.tn .brand{font:800 1.05rem var(--head);letter-spacing:.06em;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c),var(--p));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;white-space:nowrap}
.tn ul{display:flex;gap:4px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.nl{display:block;padding:.45rem .95rem;border-radius:10px;font:700 .9rem var(--head);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--mute);transition:color .25s,background .25s,transform .25s}
.nl:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(139,92,255,.22);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.nl.on{color:#fff;background:rgba(139,92,255,.2);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--c)}
.burger{display:none;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;place-items:center}
.sec,.hero{scroll-margin-top:64px}
.hero{padding-top:84px}
.player{position:relative}
.cover{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;text-align:center;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%,rgba(41,240,255,.3),transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at 85% 85%,rgba(255,61,129,.35),transparent 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1240,#0d0a20);transition:opacity .6s,visibility .6s}
.cover.off{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.cover .big{font-size:clamp(2rem,8vw,3.2rem);animation:flt 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.cover b{font:800 clamp(1rem,3.6vw,1.4rem) var(--head);letter-spacing:.08em}
.cover span{color:var(--mute);font-size:.95rem;max-width:90%}
.eq{display:flex;gap:4px;height:22px;align-items:flex-end;margin-top:6px}
.eq em{display:block;width:5px;height:100%;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(var(--c),var(--p));transform-origin:bottom;animation:eq 1s ease-in-out infinite}
.eq em:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}.eq em:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s}.eq em:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.6s}
@keyframes eq{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.25)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@keyframes flt{50%{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(-6deg)}}
.unm{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:3;font:700 .9rem var(--body);padding:.45rem .9rem;border-radius:999px;border:0;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));animation:pul 1.6s infinite}
.unm[hidden]{display:none}
@keyframes pul{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,61,129,.6)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(255,61,129,0)}}
.pl h3{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ctl{display:flex;gap:6px}
.ctl button{width:34px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.ctl button:hover{border-color:var(--c)}
.list li.bad{opacity:.45}
.chips>div{gap:14px}
.chip{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;min-width:160px;padding:1rem 1.4rem;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(139,92,255,.16),var(--panel))}
.chip .ci{font-size:2rem;line-height:1.2;transition:transform .3s}
.chip small{font:600 .8rem var(--body);letter-spacing:0;color:var(--mute);text-transform:none}
.chip:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 34px -12px var(--v),0 0 0 1px var(--c) inset}
.chip:hover .ci{transform:scale(1.25) rotate(-8deg)}
.chip[aria-expanded="true"] small{color:#fff}
@media(max-width:760px){
.burger{display:grid}
.tn ul{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;background:rgba(10,8,22,.97);padding:10px 16px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s}
.topnav.open ul{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.nl{padding:.85rem 1rem;font-size:1rem}
.wrap{padding:0 16px}.sec{padding:56px 0 20px}
.player{aspect-ratio:16/9}
input{font-size:16px!important}
.add{flex-wrap:wrap}.add input{flex:1 1 160px}
.chips>div{gap:10px}.chip{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 10px);min-width:0;padding:.9rem .6rem}
.list{max-height:200px}
}
/* ===== HIỆU ỨNG · RAINBOW · SÁNG/TỐI · HỖ TRỢ NHỎ ===== */
:root{--rl:68%;--rb:linear-gradient(90deg,hsl(0 100% var(--rl)),hsl(45 100% var(--rl)),hsl(90 100% var(--rl)),hsl(160 100% var(--rl)),hsl(200 100% var(--rl)),hsl(250 100% var(--rl)),hsl(300 100% var(--rl)),hsl(345 100% var(--rl)),hsl(0 100% var(--rl)))}
:root[data-theme=light]{--bg:#f5f2ff;--panel:#fff;--line:#d8cff8;--text:#1d1540;--mute:#665c99;--v:#6d3bff;--p:#e0206a;--c:#0b8bb0;--rl:42%;color-scheme:light}
:root[data-theme=light] .music,:root[data-theme=light] .me.hud{background:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
:root[data-theme=light] input{background:#fff}
:root[data-theme=light] .topnav{background:rgba(245,242,255,.7)}
:root[data-theme=light] .topnav.sc{background:rgba(245,242,255,.93);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -14px rgba(60,30,140,.35)}
@media(max-width:760px){:root[data-theme=light] .tn ul{background:rgba(250,248,255,.98)}}
:root[data-theme=light] .cover b{color:#fff}
:root[data-theme=light] .nl:hover,:root[data-theme=light] .nl.on{color:var(--text)}
:root[data-theme=light] .btn,:root[data-theme=light] .chip[aria-expanded="true"],:root[data-theme=light] .fc.on{color:#fff}
:root[data-theme=light] .cover span{color:#c9c0f2}
:root[data-theme=light] .glow{opacity:.55}
:root[data-theme=light] .sec::before{-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(109,59,255,.2)}
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:.9s;animation-timing-function:ease-in-out}
html.tfade,html.tfade *,html.tfade *::before,html.tfade *::after{transition:background-color .8s,color .8s,border-color .8s,box-shadow .8s,fill .8s!important}
.themebtn{width:40px;height:40px;margin-left:6px;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--c);cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.themebtn:hover{border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 18px -4px var(--c);transform:rotate(-12deg) scale(1.08)}
.themebtn svg{grid-area:1/1;width:21px;height:21px;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.2,.3,1),opacity .4s}
.themebtn .sun{transform:rotate(-90deg) scale(0);opacity:0;color:#ffb23e}
:root[data-theme=light] .themebtn .sun{transform:none;opacity:1}
:root[data-theme=light] .themebtn .moon{transform:rotate(90deg) scale(0);opacity:0}
/* chữ rainbow */
@keyframes flow{to{background-position:200% 0}}
@keyframes hue{to{filter:hue-rotate(360deg)}}
.clock,#myname,.donate-card h3,.gh,.brand,.date,#foot,.cl b{background-image:var(--rb)!important;background-size:200% 100%!important;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent;animation:flow 6s linear infinite!important}
.gh small{-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--mute)}
.glitch{background-image:var(--rb);background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:flow 6s linear infinite}
.glitch::before,.glitch::after{-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor}
.sec h2{animation:hue 10s linear infinite}
.hello{color:var(--p)}.item-btn b,.mb b{color:hsl(45 100% var(--rl))}.item-btn span{color:hsl(190 100% var(--rl))}.link-item a{color:var(--c)}.link-item .desc{color:hsl(330 100% var(--rl))}
/* hiệu ứng chuyển trang / click / cuộn */
.curtain{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;pointer-events:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
.curtain i{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1a1240,#0a0816);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1);transition-delay:calc(var(--k)*50ms);border-right:1px solid rgba(139,92,255,.3);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--c)}
.curtain.in i{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}
.curtain.boot{animation:cfail .3s 4.5s forwards}
@keyframes cfail{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
.cl{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;place-items:center;align-content:center;gap:14px;z-index:2}
.curtain.boot .cl{display:grid}.curtain.boot:not(.in) .cl{opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.cl b{font:800 clamp(1.4rem,6vw,2.4rem) var(--head);letter-spacing:.2em}
.bar{width:min(240px,60vw);height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);overflow:hidden}
.bar em{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;transform-origin:left;background:var(--rb);animation:ld 1s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes ld{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
.shock{position:fixed;width:12px;height:12px;margin:-6px 0 0 -6px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--c);pointer-events:none;z-index:99996;animation:shock .7s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes shock{to{transform:scale(9);opacity:0;border-width:0}}
.btn,.chip,.soc,.item-btn,.fc,.cp,.nl,.burger,.ctl button{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.rip{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);transform:scale(0);animation:rip .6s ease-out forwards;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:scale(1);opacity:0}}
.btn,.soc{transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s,filter .25s,translate .2s ease-out}
.rv[data-a]{transition:opacity .9s,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .9s}
.rv[data-a=l]{transform:translateX(-70px)}.rv[data-a=r]{transform:translateX(70px)}.rv[data-a=z]{transform:scale(.82)}.rv[data-a=f]{transform:perspective(800px) rotateX(22deg) translateY(50px);filter:blur(6px)}
.rv.in[data-a]{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}
.rv.in .soc{animation:pop .55s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1) backwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--n)*90ms + .3s)}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.8)}}
/* mục hỗ trợ nhỏ gọn */
#donate{padding-top:36px}
.donate-card{max-width:360px;margin:12px auto;padding:18px 16px;border-radius:16px}
.donate-card h3{font-size:1.1rem}.donate-card p{font-size:.95rem;margin:.3rem 0 .8rem}
.qr-wrap{width:min(150px,55%);border-width:2px}.qr-note{margin-top:8px;font-size:.8rem}
@media(max-width:760px){.themebtn{width:100%;margin:6px 0 0}}
/* dòng chữ chạy ngang */
.mqb{width:100vw;margin:34px 0 0 calc(50% - 50vw);overflow:hidden;padding:14px 0;border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(139,92,255,.12),rgba(255,61,129,.1),rgba(41,240,255,.12));position:relative;z-index:1}
.mqt{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mqm 30s linear infinite}
.mqb:hover .mqt{animation-play-state:paused}
.mqt span.t{font:800 clamp(1.1rem,3.4vw,1.7rem) var(--head);letter-spacing:.08em;white-space:nowrap;text-transform:uppercase;background-image:var(--rb);background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:flow 6s linear infinite}
.mqt span.msep{margin:0 1.4rem;color:var(--c);font-size:1.1rem;align-self:center;animation:spin 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes mqm{to{transform:translateX(-25%)}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
/* server minecraft */
.srvs{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:8px 0 4px}
.srv{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(62,224,138,.1),var(--panel))}
.srv-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
.srv-h b{font:800 1.1rem var(--head);color:var(--text)}
.ver{margin-left:auto;font:700 .8rem var(--head);padding:.15rem .65rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(41,240,255,.15);color:var(--c)}
.live{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#3ee08a;animation:livep 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes livep{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(62,224,138,.7)}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(62,224,138,0)}}
.srv-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.srv-r small{min-width:62px;color:var(--mute);font:700 .8rem var(--head);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.srv-r code{font:700 1rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;padding:.2rem .6rem;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.14);color:var(--text);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.srv-r a{color:var(--c);font-weight:700}.nomod{color:var(--mute)}
.cpip{font:700 .85rem var(--body);padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s}
.cpip:hover{border-color:var(--c);transform:translateY(-2px)}
/* thanh tìm kiếm */
.sli{margin-right:6px}
.sbox{position:relative;width:clamp(120px,15vw,190px);transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.sbox:focus-within{width:min(300px,34vw)}
.sbox input{width:100%;height:40px;padding:0 .8rem 0 2.3rem;border-radius:12px;font:600 .95rem var(--body)}
.sbox input:focus{border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(41,240,255,.18);outline:none}
.sbox>svg{position:absolute;left:.75rem;top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--c);pointer-events:none}
.sres{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;width:max(100%,340px);max-height:60vh;overflow:auto;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px -14px #000;padding:6px;display:none;z-index:5}
.sres.on{display:block;animation:sin .25s ease-out}
@keyframes sin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}}
.sr{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}
.sr:hover,.sr.act{background:rgba(139,92,255,.22)}
.sr .k{flex:none;font:700 .68rem var(--head);padding:.12rem .5rem;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(41,240,255,.15);color:var(--c);white-space:nowrap;max-width:96px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sr>span:last-child{min-width:0}
.sr b{display:block;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.25;color:var(--text);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.sr small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:.8rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.sr mark{background:rgba(255,200,61,.4);color:inherit;border-radius:3px}
.sempty{padding:12px;color:var(--mute)}
@keyframes hit{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 transparent}30%,70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--c),0 0 30px var(--c)}}
.hit{animation:hit 1.8s ease 1;border-radius:12px}
:root[data-theme=light] .sres{box-shadow:0 20px 50px -14px rgba(60,30,140,.35)}
@media(max-width:760px){.sli{width:100%;margin:0 0 6px}.sbox,.sbox:focus-within{width:100%}.sres{position:static;width:100%;margin-top:6px;max-height:40vh;box-shadow:none}}
/* hướng dẫn từng bước */
.gdl{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:8px 0 4px}
.gd{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.08)}
.gd>i{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 .95rem var(--head);font-style:normal;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p))}
.gd b{color:var(--c);font:700 1rem var(--head)}
.gd p{margin:.2rem 0 0;color:var(--text);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.5}
.gdb{display:inline-block;margin-top:.55rem;padding:.35rem .95rem;border-radius:10px;font:700 .85rem var(--head);letter-spacing:.03em;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.gdb:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px -10px var(--p)}
/* ===== CÔNG CỤ ===== */
.tgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:22px}
.tc{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;text-align:left;padding:18px 16px 16px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(139,92,255,.14),var(--panel));color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.tc::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(41,240,255,.2),transparent 55%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
.tc:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 16px 36px -16px var(--v)}
.tc:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tc.on{border-color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--p) inset,0 16px 40px -16px var(--p)}
.rv.in .tc{animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1) backwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--n)*70ms + .2s)}
.ti{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;font-size:1.5rem;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p));box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px var(--p);transition:transform .4s}
.tc:hover .ti{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.12)}
.tc b{font:800 1.05rem var(--head)}.tc small{color:var(--mute);font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.4}
.tc em{font:700 .68rem var(--head);font-style:normal;padding:.12rem .55rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(62,224,138,.16);color:#2fbf72;margin-top:2px}
.tc em.net{background:rgba(255,178,62,.18);color:#e0952a}
.tpanel{margin-top:18px}
.tp{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:20px;background:var(--panel);animation:tin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes tin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98)}}
.th{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.th h3{margin:0;font:800 1.25rem var(--head)}.th p{margin:.15rem 0 0;color:var(--mute);font-size:.92rem}
.tx{margin-left:auto;flex:none;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.tx:hover{border-color:var(--p)}
.tsteps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0;list-style:none;counter-reset:s}
.tsteps li{counter-increment:s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mute);padding:.25rem .8rem .25rem .3rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.1)}
.tsteps li::before{content:counter(s);display:grid;place-items:center;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;font:800 .72rem var(--head);color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p))}
.dz{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:28px 16px;border:2px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:border-color .25s,background .25s,transform .25s}
.dz:hover,.dz.drag{border-color:var(--c);background:rgba(41,240,255,.07)}.dz.drag{transform:scale(1.015)}
.dz i{font-style:normal;font-size:1.8rem;animation:flt 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.dz span{color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem}
.tp select,.tp input[type=number],.tp input[type=url],.tp textarea{padding:.5rem .8rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font:600 .95rem var(--body)}
.tp input[type=number]{width:110px}.tp textarea{width:100%;resize:vertical;margin-top:4px}
.tp select:focus,.tp input:focus,.tp textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--c)}
.tr{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 14px;margin:12px 0}
.tr label,.ck{font:700 .85rem var(--head);color:var(--mute)}.ck{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer}
.tp input[type=range]{flex:1 1 160px;accent-color:var(--v)}
.tbtn{padding:.5rem 1rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font:700 .9rem var(--body);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.tbtn:hover{border-color:var(--c);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.tbtn.p{border:0;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--v),var(--p))}
.rw{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 12px;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.07);animation:tin .35s}
.rw b{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.rw small{color:var(--mute)}
.rs{color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem}.rs.bad{color:#ff5f86}
.bar2{height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.18);overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px}.bar2 i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--rb);transition:width .15s linear}
.tnote{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.5}
.rbox{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:18px;margin-top:14px}
.rbox img,.rbox video{width:100%;max-height:300px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.pwo{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.pwo input{flex:1 1 220px;padding:.55rem .8rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font:700 1.1rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.meter{height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.18);overflow:hidden;margin-top:6px}.meter i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;transition:width .3s,background .3s}
.rres{margin:14px 0;min-height:76px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font:800 clamp(1.4rem,5vw,2.2rem) var(--head);color:var(--text);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:10px}
.rres.win{background-image:var(--rb);background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:flow 4s linear infinite,tin .5s}
.sysg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:10px}
.sysi{padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.07)}
.sysi small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font:700 .72rem var(--head);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}.sysi b{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ttc{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(139,92,255,.07)}
.ttc img{width:110px;height:150px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px}.ttc>div{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0}.ttc small{display:block;color:var(--mute)}
.tbad{color:#ff5f86;margin-top:10px}
@media(max-width:760px){.rbox{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}.tc{padding:14px 12px}.tc small{font-size:.8rem}.tp{padding:14px}.ttc img{width:80px;height:110px}}
.rbox[hidden]{display:none}
.tp input[type=checkbox]{width:auto;flex:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.tp [hidden]{display:none!important}
.tp input[type=color]{width:44px;height:34px;padding:2px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.tp canvas{display:block}
.tp .tres{margin-top:6px}
.tp .tr>select{max-width:100%}
.tp input[type=range]{min-width:0;padding:0;border:0;background:none}
.tr label.ck{flex-direction:row}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="curtain in boot" id="curtain" aria-hidden="true"><i style="--k:0"></i><i style="--k:1"></i><i style="--k:2"></i><i style="--k:3"></i><i style="--k:4"></i><div class="cl"><b id="cln">NAM HOÀNG</b><span class="bar"><em></em></span></div></div>
<canvas id="fx" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<div class="glow" id="glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="prog" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<nav class="topnav" id="topnav" aria-label="Menu chính"><div class="tn"><a class="brand" id="brand" href="#top">NAM HOÀNG</a><button class="burger" id="burger" type="button" aria-label="Mở menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nl">☰</button><ul id="nl"><li class="sli"><div class="sbox"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input id="gs" type="search" placeholder="Tìm kiếm… ( / )" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Tìm kiếm nội dung trang"><div class="sres" id="sres" role="listbox"></div></div></li><li><a class="nl" href="#top">Trang chủ</a></li><li><a class="nl" href="#me">Liên hệ</a></li><li><a class="nl" href="#games">Game</a></li><li><a class="nl" href="#tools">Công cụ</a></li><li><a class="nl" href="#donate">Hỗ trợ</a></li><li><button class="themebtn" id="theme" type="button" aria-label="Chuyển giao diện sáng hoặc tối" title="Sáng / Tối"><svg class="moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8z" fill="currentColor"/></svg><svg class="sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.2" fill="currentColor"/><g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 2.5v2.4M12 19.1v2.4M2.5 12h2.4M19.1 12h2.4M5.3 5.3l1.7 1.7M17 17l1.7 1.7M5.3 18.7L7 17M17 7l1.7-1.7"/></g></svg></button></li></ul></div></nav>
<button class="totop" id="totop" type="button" aria-label="Lên đầu trang">↑</button>
<!-- ============ BANNER GIỜ + NHẠC ============ -->
<header class="hero" id="top"><div class="wrap">
<p class="hello" id="hello">Xin chào</p>
<div class="clock" id="clock" role="timer" aria-label="Giờ hiện tại"><span id="hh">00</span><span class="colon">:</span><span id="mm">00</span><span class="colon">:</span><span class="s" id="ss">00</span></div>
<p class="date" id="date"></p>
<h1 style="margin:0;font:800 clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.2rem) var(--head)"><span class="glitch" data-t="CHÀO MỪNG ĐẾN GÓC GAME">CHÀO MỪNG ĐẾN GÓC GAME</span></h1>
<div class="type" id="type"></div>
<div class="music hud" id="music">
<div class="player"><div id="yt"></div><div class="cover" id="cover" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Bấm để phát nhạc"><div class="big">🎮🎧</div><b>GÓC NHẠC GAME</b><span id="cvs">Đang tải nhạc…</span><i class="eq"><em></em><em></em><em></em><em></em></i></div><button class="unm" id="unm" type="button" hidden>🔊 Bật tiếng</button></div>
<div class="pl">
<h3><span>♪ DANH SÁCH NHẠC</span><span class="ctl"><button id="prv" type="button" aria-label="Bài trước">⏮</button><button id="nxt" type="button" aria-label="Bài tiếp">⏭</button></span></h3>
<ul class="list" id="list"></ul>
<div class="add"><input id="url" placeholder="Dán link YouTube..." aria-label="Link YouTube"><button class="btn" id="addbtn" type="button">Thêm</button></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="scroll">CUỘN XUỐNG ↓</div>
</div></header>
<main class="wrap">
<!-- ============ THÔNG TIN CỦA TÔI ============ -->
<section class="sec" id="me" data-n="01">
<div class="rv"><span class="tag">// Liên Hệ</span><h2>Thông tin của tôi</h2></div>
<div class="me rv hud">
<div class="avatar"><img id="av" alt="Ảnh đại diện" src="images/avatar.jpg"></div>
<div>
<h3 id="myname">Nam Hoàng</h3><p id="mybio">Game thủ chính hiệu. Thích chơi game, nghe nhạc và chia sẻ mod, tips cho anh em.</p>
<div class="socials" id="socials"></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="mqb" id="mqb" aria-hidden="true"><div class="mqt" id="mqt"></div></div>
<!-- ============ GAME ============ -->
<section class="sec" id="games" data-n="02">
<div class="rv"><span class="tag">// Game</span><h2>Kho game của tôi</h2><p style="color:var(--mute);margin:0">Bấm chọn game → chọn mục → xem danh sách link tải.</p></div>
<button class="btn open rv" id="open" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="chips">🎮 Chọn game</button>
<div class="chips" id="chips"><div id="chipbox" role="list"></div></div>
<div class="gpanel" id="gp"><div id="gcontent"></div></div>
</section>
<!-- ============ TOOLS ============ -->
<section class="sec" id="tools" data-n="03">
<div class="rv"><span class="tag">// Công cụ</span><h2>Công cụ hữu ích</h2><p style="color:var(--mute);margin:0">Chạy ngay trên trình duyệt: file của bạn được xử lý ngay trên máy bạn, không tải lên đâu cả. Chọn một công cụ để bắt đầu.</p></div>
<div class="tgrid rv" id="tgrid" role="list"></div>
<div class="tpanel" id="tpanel" aria-live="polite"></div>
</section>
<!-- ============ DONATE ============ -->
<section class="sec rv" id="donate" data-n="03">
<span class="tag">// Hỗ trợ</span>
<h2>💖 Hỗ trợ tôi</h2>
<div class="donate-card hud">
<h3>Ủng hộ cà phê</h3>
<p>Nếu thấy chia sẻ hữu ích, bạn có thể ủng hộ mình qua mã QR bên dưới. Mình rất cảm kích! ❤️</p>
<div class="qr-wrap">
<img id="qr-img" src="images/qr.jpg" alt="Mã QR ủng hộ">
</div>
<p class="qr-note">Quét mã QR để ủng hộ</p>
</div>
</section>
</main>
<footer>© <span id="yr"></span> <span id="foot">Nam Hoàng</span> · Chúc bạn chơi game vui vẻ</footer>
<script>
/* =====================================================================
CẤU HÌNH – CHỈ CẦN SỬA PHẦN NÀY
===================================================================== */
/* ---- ẢNH MAP: tự lấy từ thư mục, KHÔNG nhúng trong code ----
Ảnh của map nằm trong thư mục MAP_DIR, tên file = đúng tên map (t) + .jpg
Ví dụ: t:"Route 66" -> anh-map/Route 66.jpg
Không có ảnh thì web tự hiện ảnh màu thay thế, không bị lỗi. */
var MAP_DIR="anh-map/", MAP_EXT=".jpg";
/* ---- DANH SÁCH MAP SINH TỒN (Red Alert 2) ----
THÊM MAP MỚI: copy 1 dòng bên dưới, sửa các thông số rồi thêm ảnh vào thư mục anh-map
t = tên map (cũng là tên file ảnh) p = số người chơi
d = độ khó: "Dễ" | "Trung Bình" | "Khó" | "Cực Khó" | "Siêu Cấp"
s = cỡ map: "Nhỏ" | "Vừa" | "Rộng" u = link tải
(Có thể ghi thêm img:"duong/dan/anh.jpg" nếu muốn dùng ảnh khác tên) */
var MAPS=[
{t:"Up Side Down Temp",p:8,d:"Dễ",s:"Vừa",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/sscutde5nzunam7/USD+Temp.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down Super V1.2",p:8,d:"Trung Bình",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/km8fqc2ftwhbk7j/upsidedown+super+v1.2.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down Super Water Lv2",p:8,d:"Khó",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/pz8h6pkeg3sjl2p/upsidedown+super+water++Lv2.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down Super Water Lv6.1",p:8,d:"Khó",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/nmy4hwj435x4bja/upsidedown+super+water++Lv6.1.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down Super Water Lv6.1 Snow",p:8,d:"Cực Khó",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/7hfd12vephhvuxt/upsidedown+super+water++Lv6.1_Snow.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down Super Water Speed Up",p:8,d:"Cực Khó",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/9qsnvv7sdparzvu/upsidedown+super+water++Speed+Up.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down Super Water Lv7",p:8,d:"Cực Khó",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/k1wwuacrvpirhzv/upsidedown+super+water++Lv7.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down NH V2.2",p:8,d:"Dễ",s:"Vừa",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/yruxuv3j5ln1bld/upsidedownnh+ver2.2.mpr/file"},
{t:"Up Side Down NH V2.3",p:8,d:"Dễ",s:"Vừa",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/jfg1jty6etkeybt/upsidedownnh+ver2.3+Warter.mpr/file"},
{t:"USD City War",p:8,d:"Trung Bình",s:"Vừa",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/wnzpoqcfm0i28yq/USD+City+War.mpr/file"},
{t:"USD Snow",p:8,d:"Trung Bình",s:"Vừa",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/h47mn9xjzf17e8t/USD+Snow.mpr/file"},
{t:"USD Super War Ship Easy Temp",p:8,d:"Khó",s:"Rộng",u:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/lfd6gxsh8kbl8m4/USD+Super+War+Ship+Snow+Easy+Temp.mpr/file"},

guide:[
{h:"Chuẩn bị công cụ",p:"Cài Red Alert 2 kèm Yuri's Revenge và một trình soạn map như FinalAlert 2. Luôn sao lưu file map gốc trước khi sửa.",url:"https://www.mediafire.com/file/qf5vt6ii2cks8k6/FinalAlert+2+Yuri's+Revenge.rar/file"},
{h:"Mở và chỉnh bản đồ",p:"Mở file map, chỉnh địa hình, quặng, công trình. Đặt Waypoint để làm vị trí xuất phát cho từng người chơi.",url:"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R0T1O6Y3QBI"},
{h:"Tạo Trigger",p:"Mỗi trigger gồm Sự kiện (Event) là điều kiện kích hoạt và Hành động (Action) là việc sẽ xảy ra. Chọn phe sở hữu, đặt chạy một lần hoặc lặp lại. Ví dụ: sau 5 phút thì gọi quân tiếp viện.",url:"https://example.com/ra2-buoc-3"},
{h:"Tạo đội quân và kịch bản",p:"Dùng Team Type, Task Force và Script để quy định đội nào xuất hiện, đi đâu, tấn công gì. Trigger sẽ gọi các đội này ra.",url:"https://example.com/ra2-buoc-4"},
{h:"Quy tắc tự định nghĩa",p:"Muốn đổi giá, tốc độ hay sát thương, hãy ghi đè thông số bằng các mục INI trong file map hoặc file rules của mod. Chỉ sửa đúng mục cần đổi.",url:"https://example.com/ra2-buoc-5"},
{h:"Chạy thử và hoàn thiện",p:"Lưu map, vào chế độ Skirmish thử nhiều lần, sửa lỗi trigger rồi mới chia sẻ cho mọi người.",url:"https://example.com/ra2-buoc-6"}
]
}
]

(function(){var i=0,j=0,del=false,el=$("type");if(RM){el.textContent=CFG.typing[0]||"";return}
(function step(){var w=CFG.typing[i]||"";j+=del?-1:1;el.textContent=w.slice(0,j);var t=del?35:70;
if(!del&&j===w.length){del=true;t=1400}else if(del&&j===0){del=false;i=(i+1)%CFG.typing.length;t=300}
setTimeout(step,t)})()})();
function ytId(s){s=String(s).trim();var m=s.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/|embed\/|shorts\/|live\/)([\w-]{11})/);if(m)return m[1];return/^[\w-]{11}$/.test(s)?s:null}
var PRESET=CFG.music.map(function(m){return{id:ytId(m.id),t:m.t,fixed:1}}).filter(function(m){return m.id});
var userT=[];try{userT=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("g_music_user")||"[]").filter(function(m){return m&&ytId(m.id)})}catch(e){}
var tracks=PRESET.concat(userT),cur=0,yp=null,fails=0,unlocked=false;
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem("g_music_user",JSON.stringify(tracks.filter(function(t){return!t.fixed}).map(function(t){return{id:t.id,t:t.t}})))}catch(e){}}
function say(t,show){if(t)$("cvs").textContent=t;$("cover").classList.toggle("off",!show)}
function play(i){if(!tracks.length){say("Chưa có bài nào. Hãy dán link YouTube bên dưới.",true);drawList();return}
cur=((i%tracks.length)+tracks.length)%tracks.length;say("Đang tải: "+tracks[cur].t,true);
if(yp&&yp.loadVideoById)yp.loadVideoById(tracks[cur].id);drawList()}
function drawList(){$("list").innerHTML=tracks.map(function(t,i){return'<li class="'+(i===cur?"on":"")+(t.bad?" bad":"")+'" data-i="'+i+'" tabindex="0"><img src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/'+t.id+'/default.jpg" alt=""><span>'+esc(t.t)+'</span>'+(t.fixed?"":'<button type="button" data-d="'+i+'" aria-label="Xóa bài">✕</button>')+'</li>'}).join("")||'<li style="cursor:default">Chưa có bài nào. Hãy dán link YouTube bên dưới.</li>'}
function fetchTitle(t){fetch("https://www.youtube.com/oembed?format=json&url="+encodeURIComponent("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v="+t.id)).then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(function(j){if(j&&j.title){t.t=j.title;if(!t.fixed)save();drawList()}}).catch(function(){})}
function unlock(){unlocked=true;$("unm").hidden=true;try{if(yp&&yp.unMute){yp.unMute();yp.setVolume(100)}}catch(e){}}
["pointerdown","keydown","touchstart"].forEach(function(ev){addEventListener(ev,unlock,{once:true,passive:true})});
$("unm").onclick=unlock;
$("cover").onclick=function(){unlock();try{yp&&yp.playVideo()}catch(e){}};
$("cover").addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();this.click()}});
$("prv").onclick=function(){play(cur-1)};$("nxt").onclick=function(){play(cur+1)};
window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady=function(){
var pv={autoplay:1,mute:1,rel:0,modestbranding:1,playsinline:1};if(/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol))pv.origin=location.origin;
yp=new YT.Player("yt",{host:"https://www.youtube-nocookie.com",videoId:tracks[cur]?tracks[cur].id:undefined,playerVars:pv,events:{
onReady:function(){if(unlocked){unlock()}else{$("unm").hidden=false}
if(tracks.length)yp.playVideo();
setTimeout(function(){try{if(yp.getPlayerState()!==1&&tracks.length)say("Bấm vào đây để bắt đầu nghe nhạc ▶",true)}catch(e){}},4000)},
onStateChange:function(e){if(e.data===1){fails=0;say("",false)}else if(e.data===0){play(cur+1)}},
onError:function(){fails++;if(tracks[cur])tracks[cur].bad=1;drawList();
if(fails>=tracks.length){say("Chưa phát được bài nào. Hãy thử thêm link YouTube khác bên dưới.",true);return}
say("Bài này không phát được, đang chuyển bài…",true);setTimeout(function(){play(cur+1)},1200)}}})};
(function(){var t=document.createElement("script");t.src="https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";t.async=true;document.head.appendChild(t);
setTimeout(function(){if(!yp)say("Chưa tải được trình phát nhạc. Kiểm tra mạng rồi tải lại trang nhé.",true)},9000)})();
$("list").addEventListener("click",function(e){var d=e.target.closest("[data-d]");
if(d){e.stopPropagation();var k=+d.dataset.d,was=k===cur;tracks.splice(k,1);save();if(k<cur)cur--;if(was)play(cur);else drawList();return}
var li=e.target.closest("li[data-i]");if(li)play(+li.dataset.i)});
$("list").addEventListener("keydown",function(e){var li=e.target.closest("li[data-i]");if(li&&(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" ")){e.preventDefault();play(+li.dataset.i)}});
function addTrack(){var id=ytId($("url").value);if(!id){$("url").style.borderColor="var(--p)";$("url").placeholder="Link chưa đúng, thử lại";return}
$("url").style.borderColor="";$("url").value="";$("url").placeholder="Dán link YouTube...";
var t={id:id,t:"Bài mới ("+id+")"};tracks.push(t);save();fetchTitle(t);play(tracks.length-1)}
$("addbtn").onclick=addTrack;$("url").addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Enter")addTrack()});
PRESET.forEach(fetchTitle);drawList();

function srvHtml(a){return'<div class="srvs">'+a.map(function(v){return'<div class="srv"><div class="srv-h"><span class="live" title="Đang hoạt động"></span><b>'+esc(v.name)+'</b><span class="ver">'+esc(v.ver)+'</span></div><div class="srv-r"><small>IP</small><code>'+esc(v.ip)+'</code><button type="button" class="cpip" data-ip="'+esc(v.ip)+'">Chép IP</button></div><div class="srv-r"><small>Link Mod</small>'+(v.mod?'<a href="'+esc(v.mod)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">⬇ Tải mod</a>':'<span class="nomod">Không cần mod</span>')+'</div></div>'}).join("")+'</div>'}
function renderGame(gIdx){
var g=CFG.games[gIdx];
var html='<button class="back-btn" id="backGame">← Quay lại danh sách game</button>';
html+='<div class="gh">'+esc(g.name)+' <small>· '+esc(g.note||"")+'</small></div>';
html+='<div class="item-list">';
g.items.forEach(function(item,i){
html+='<div><div class="item-btn" data-i="'+i+'"><b>'+esc(item.t)+'</b><span>'+esc(item.note||"")+'</span></div>';
html+='<div class="link-list" id="links-'+i+'"><div>';
(item.links||[]).forEach(function(lnk,j){
html+='<div class="link-item"><a href="'+esc(lnk.url)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 '+esc(lnk.name)+'</a><span class="desc">'+esc(lnk.desc||"")+'</span></div>';
});
if(item.maps)html+='<div class="mapg"></div>';if(item.servers)html+=srvHtml(item.servers);if(item.guide)html+=guideHtml(item.guide);
html+='</div></div></div>';
});
html+='</div>';
$("gcontent").innerHTML=html;
$("gp").classList.add("on");
setTimeout(function(){$("gp").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"})},300);
// Nút quay lại
$("backGame").onclick=function(){$("gp").classList.remove("on");openG=-1;openItem=-1;document.querySelectorAll(".chip").forEach(function(c){c.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false")})};
// Mở/đóng danh sách link
document.querySelectorAll(".item-btn").forEach(function(btn){
btn.onclick=function(){var i=+this.dataset.i;var box=$("links-"+i);var isOn=box.classList.toggle("on");this.style.borderColor=isOn?"var(--c)":"";this.style.background=isOn?"rgba(139,92,255,.15)":"";
this.classList.toggle("open",isOn);if(isOn){var it=CFG.games[openG].items[i];if(it.maps)initGallery(box.querySelector(".mapg"),it.maps);box.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"});openItem=i}else{openItem=-1}};
});
}
$("chipbox").addEventListener("click",function(e){var b=e.target.closest(".chip");if(!b)return;var i=+b.dataset.g;
document.querySelectorAll(".chip").forEach(function(c){c.setAttribute("aria-expanded",c===b&&openG!==i)});
if(openG===i){$("gp").classList.remove("on");openG=-1;openItem=-1;return}
openG=i;renderGame(i);
});

(function(){var cv=$("fx"),x=cv.getContext("2d"),W,H,P=[],gl=$("glow");
function size(){W=cv.width=innerWidth;H=cv.height=innerHeight;P=[];var n=Math.min(70,Math.floor(W*H/22000));for(var i=0;i<n;i++)P.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:Math.random()*2+.6,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,vy:-Math.random()*.5-.1,c:["#8b5cff","#29f0ff","#ff3d81"][i%3]})}
size();addEventListener("resize",size);
if(!RM)(function loop(){x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);P.forEach(function(p){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.y<-5){p.y=H+5;p.x=Math.random()*W}if(p.x<-5)p.x=W+5;if(p.x>W+5)p.x=-5;x.globalAlpha=.7;x.fillStyle=p.c;x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.283);x.fill()});
for(var i=0;i<P.length;i++)for(var j=i+1;j<P.length;j++){var dx=P[i].x-P[j].x,dy=P[i].y-P[j].y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<9000){x.globalAlpha=(1-d/9000)*.18;x.strokeStyle="#8b5cff";x.beginPath();x.moveTo(P[i].x,P[i].y);x.lineTo(P[j].x,P[j].y);x.stroke()}}
requestAnimationFrame(loop)})();
addEventListener("pointermove",function(e){gl.style.transform="translate("+e.clientX+"px,"+e.clientY+"px) translate(-50%,-50%)"},{passive:true});
})();

(function(){

h.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "))})});

el._i=setInterval(function(){el.textContent=t.split("").map(function(c,j){return j<i||c===" "?c:cs.charAt(Math.random()*cs.length|0)}).join("");if(++i>t.length)clearInterval(el._i)},45)}

(function lp(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.18;ry+=(my-ry)*.18;ring.style.transform="translate("+rx+"px,"+ry+"px)";requestAnimationFrame(lp)})();
document.addEventListener("pointerover",function(e){ring.classList.toggle("hv",!!e.target.closest("a,button,.item-btn,.chip,.fc,.mcard,li[data-i],.soc"))});
addEventListener("pointerdown",function(e){ring.classList.add("dn");for(var i=0;i<10;i++)spark(e.clientX,e.clientY,true)});
addEventListener("pointerup",function(){ring.classList.remove("dn")});
document.documentElement.addEventListener("mouseleave",function(){dot.style.opacity=ring.style.opacity=0});
document.documentElement.addEventListener("mouseenter",function(){dot.style.opacity=ring.style.opacity=1})}
/* Thư viện map: ảnh + thông tin + link tải */
var DFC={"Dễ":"d0","Trung Bình":"d1","Khó":"d2","Cực Khó":"d3","Siêu Cấp":"d4"};
function bk(p){return p<=3?"2-3":p<=5?"4-5":p==6?"6":"8"}
function shortU(u){return u.replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?/,"")}
function chips(k,a){return'<div class="fg" data-k="'+k+'"><button type="button" class="fc on" data-v="all">Tất cả</button>'+a.map(function(v){return'<button type="button" class="fc" data-v="'+v+'">'+v+'</button>'}).join("")+'</div>'}
window.initGallery=function(box,maps){
if(box.dataset.ok)return;box.dataset.ok=1;var st={q:"",pl:"all",df:"all",sz:"all"};
box.innerHTML='<div class="mapbar"><div class="mtot"><b class="mc">0</b><span>map có ảnh + link tải</span></div><input class="mq" type="search" placeholder="Tìm tên map..." aria-label="Tìm map">'+
'<div class="fl"><small>Số người</small>'+chips("pl",["2-3","4-5","6","8"])+'</div>'+
'<div class="fl"><small>Độ khó</small>'+chips("df",["Dễ","Trung Bình","Khó","Cực Khó","Siêu Cấp"])+'</div>'+
'<div class="fl"><small>Cỡ map</small>'+chips("sz",["Nhỏ","Vừa","Rộng"])+'</div></div><div class="mgrid"></div>';
var grid=box.querySelector(".mgrid"),cnt=box.querySelector(".mc"),first=true;
function draw(){var h="",n=0;
maps.forEach(function(m,i){
if(st.q&&m.t.toLowerCase().indexOf(st.q)<0)return;
if(st.pl!=="all"&&bk(m.p)!==st.pl)return;if(st.df!=="all"&&m.d!==st.df)return;if(st.sz!=="all"&&m.s!==st.sz)return;
var id=(m.u.match(/file\/(\w+)/)||[])[1],img=m.img||(MAP_DIR+encodeURIComponent(m.t)+MAP_EXT);
h+='<article class="mcard" data-id="'+id+'" style="animation-delay:'+Math.min(n,24)*40+'ms"><div class="mth"><img src="'+esc(img)+'" alt="Ảnh map '+esc(m.t)+'" loading="lazy" data-i="'+i+'"><span class="pn">👥 '+m.p+'</span><span class="sz">'+esc(m.s)+'</span></div><div class="mb"><b>'+esc(m.t)+'</b><div class="mrow"><span class="df '+(DFC[m.d]||"d1")+'">'+esc(m.d)+'</span></div><div class="ma"><a class="btn dlb" href="'+esc(m.u)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">⬇ Tải map</a><button type="button" class="cp" data-i="'+i+'">Chép link</button></div></div></article>';n++});
grid.innerHTML=h||'<div class="mempty">Không có map nào khớp bộ lọc.</div>';
if(first&&!RM){first=false;var t0=performance.now();(function c(t){var k=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/900);cnt.textContent=Math.round(n*k);if(k<1)requestAnimationFrame(c)})(t0)}else cnt.textContent=n}
box.addEventListener("click",function(e){var c=e.target.closest(".fc");
if(c){var g=c.parentNode;g.querySelectorAll(".fc").forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle("on",x===c)});st[g.dataset.k]=c.dataset.v;draw();return}
var p=e.target.closest(".cp");if(p){var u=maps[+p.dataset.i].u,ok=function(){p.textContent="Đã chép ✓";setTimeout(function(){p.textContent="Chép link"},1400)},no=function(){window.prompt("Sao chép link:",u)};
try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(u).then(ok,no)}catch(x){no()}}});
grid.addEventListener("error",function(e){var im=e.target;if(im.tagName!=="IMG"||im.dataset.f)return;im.dataset.f=1;var i=+im.dataset.i;im.src=art(maps[i].t,i)},true);
box.querySelector(".mq").addEventListener("input",function(){st.q=this.value.toLowerCase().trim();draw()});
draw()};
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){var nav=$("topnav"),ls=[].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll("a.nl")),ids=ls.map(function(a){return a.getAttribute("href").slice(1)});
$("brand").textContent=CFG.name.toUpperCase();
function on(){nav.classList.toggle("sc",scrollY>20);if(nav.classList.contains("open")){nav.classList.remove("open");$("burger").textContent="☰"}var c=0;ids.forEach(function(id,i){var el=$(id);if(el&&el.getBoundingClientRect().top<innerHeight*.4)c=i});ls.forEach(function(a,i){a.classList.toggle("on",i===c)})}
addEventListener("scroll",on,{passive:true});on();
$("burger").onclick=function(){var o=nav.classList.toggle("open");this.setAttribute("aria-expanded",o);this.textContent=o?"✕":"☰"};
nav.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target.closest("a.nl")){nav.classList.remove("open");$("burger").textContent="☰"}});
})();
</script>
